Notes: FACT: Specification CWP-040-001/004 requires cross-check against Scope of Work identity and responsibility model.

Statement: CWP-040-013 and Procedure Step 7 require vendor IFC drawings and equipment lists before final equipment ratings and settings can be confirmed in the work package. Specification CWP-040-005 also requires the building module installation to match vendor-supplied IFC drawings.
EvidenceQuote: shall not assume final equipment ratings or settings before... vendor IFC drawings for 860-1
Notes: FACT: Specification explicitly names vendor IFC drawings as a required input gate before finalizing equipment ratings.

Statement: Procedure Step 7 requires vendor data sheets for 860-1 MCC, transformers, UPS, panelboards, SCR heater control panels, and supporting equipment as inputs to the construction work package. These are produced under the Vendor Document Turnover deliverable.
EvidenceQuote: Confirm or list as open: vendor IFC drawings equipment lists vendor data sheets for 860-1 MCC transformers UPS panelboards SCR heater control panels
Notes: FACT: Procedure Step 7 explicitly names vendor data sheets as required construction inputs.

Statement: CWP-040-011 states the CWP shall NOT treat building coordinates, road geometry, and inter-unit spacing as final until plot plan CIV-235633-5002 is received and reviewed. This is an explicit constraint on construction scope finalization.
EvidenceQuote: shall NOT treat building coordinates… as final until plot plan CIV-235633-5002 is received and reviewed
Notes: FACT: Specification CWP-040-011 explicitly blocks finalization of coordinates on receipt of plot plan.

Statement: CWP-040-012 states the CWP shall NOT treat geotechnical or topographical design parameters as final construction criteria until the geotechnical assessment and topographical survey are completed. Bearing capacity, lateral pile design, LPILE curves, dynamic criteria, and pavement design remain TBD.
EvidenceQuote: NOT treat geotechnical or topographical design parameters as final construction criteria until the geotechnical assessment and topographical survey are completed
Notes: FACT: Specification CWP-040-012 explicitly blocks geotechnical/topographical parameters until report is received.

Statement: CWP-040-013 states the CWP shall not assume final equipment ratings or settings before completion of the required electrical studies: hazardous-area classification, load analysis, short-circuit, relay coordination/arc-flash, and load-flow. These are external prerequisite deliverables not yet assigned a deliverable ID in the decomposition.
EvidenceQuote: not assume final equipment ratings or settings before completion of the required electrical studies
Notes: FACT: Specification CWP-040-013 makes electrical studies a hard gate for finalizing equipment ratings.
